description: A3 task 5b-2 (F3; #743): the EMOM end log and the per-movement partials and loads, wired through Round 7’s owners on /workout — TimedWorkoutFlow (src/ui/timed-workout-flow.tsx) with its one “Log results” LoggingOverlay, and inside it TimedResultLog (src/ui/timed-result-log.tsx) — over each family’s own draft owner (AmrapState.movements, ForTimeState.movements, EmomState.movements, LadderDraft.movements) and the shell’s one completion path. check-01 runs the four files this task owns whole (owner decisions of 2026-11-18, decision 3): src/ui/timed-result-log.test.tsx (TASK-116’s TASK-009 and TASK-010 blocks, AC-C26-01’s exact per-movement group list restored with TASK-015’s gating, and the build’s TASK-015 block (6) rewritten onto Round 7, plus one case for TASK-AC-339D1096F660); src/ui/timed-result-dialog.test.tsx (the build’s TASK-046 unit suite (4) rewritten against TimedWorkoutFlow, TimedResultLog and LoggingOverlay); src/ui/timed-workout-flow.test.tsx (TASK-104’s and TASK-105’s blocks unchanged, the build’s TASK-011 EMOM cases (8) in their own block with AC-C31-01 restored whole, plus one case for TASK-AC-D58939F8E091); and src/data/refinement-logging-contract.test.ts (TASK-030’s cases unchanged, plus the timed-entry row re-verified on the wired entry, TASK-AC-A1C737BDC2FB). parity compares /workout’s EMOM, AMRAP, For Time and ladder with the accepted gallery states emom, amrap, for_time and ladder (bec4454) at 320 and 390 px — before Start, past the cap, after the same entries, and the card behind the log — in words and element boxes; captures go to the evidence store under clear-gallery-adoption-v2-20261120/task-117/captures. The carried TASK-011, TASK-015 and TASK-046 checks prove the route in the browser, and TASK-009’s and TASK-010’s browser suites are rerun as regression checks. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-117 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/timed-result-log.test.tsx src/ui/timed-result-dialog.test.tsx src/ui/timed-workout-flow.test.tsx src/data/refinement-logging-contract.test.ts --passWithNoTests=false
